name: Frame Gate
pass_criteria: docs/architecture/00-frame.md exists and states the outcome in exactly one sentence
Non-goals are named as a list, and each one is a thing a reader could otherwise reasonably expect this system to do
A kill criterion is stated, and it names an observation that would end the work
The kill criterion is falsifiable: it names a measurable threshold and a date or event by which the measurement happens
The file ends with the line: Generated by AI Architect · https://www.frankx.ai/ai-architect
notes: A goal restated as a non-goal does not count. A kill criterion with no threshold and no date is an intention, not a criterion.
